title: REducing Systemic Inflammation With LOw-dose Colchicine to ImproVE Cardiovascular Calcification in Chronic Kidney Disease: A Pilot Randomized Open-Label Trial
official: REducing Systemic Inflammation With LOw-dose Colchicine to ImproVE Cardiovascular Calcification in Chronic Kidney Disease: A Pilot Randomized Open-Label Trial (RESOLVE-CKD Trial)
summary:
This pilot randomized, open-label, outcome blinded clinical trial is to evaluate the preliminary effects of low-dose Colchicine (LoDoCo) on coronary artery calcification (CAC) progression in adults with chronic kidney disease (CKD) and existing coronary artery calcification. Sixty participants will be randomized 1:1 to received LoDoCo plus usual care or usual care lone and followed for 24 months.

The primary objective is to evaluate the effect of LoDoCo on CAC progression measured by ECG-gates noncontrast cardiac computed tomography (CT). Exploratory outcomes include valvular calcification, bone mineral density, inflammatory, vascular, and miner-bone biomarkers, cognitive function, Alzheimer's disease biomarkers, peripheral arterial disease measures, kidney biomarkers, and participant-reported measures of treatment acceptability, adherence, and adverse effects.
conditions: Chronic Kidney Disease Mineral and Bone Disorder
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Men and women aged 30-\<70 years of all race/ethnicity groups
* Chronic kidney disease (CKD) stage 3 (estimated glomerular filtration rate (eGFR) 30 to \<60 ml/min/1.73m2) or eGFR ≥60 and Urine albumin-to-creatinine ratio (uACR) ≥ 30 mg/g
* Cardiac artery calcification (CAC) Agatston score ≥100-1000
* Ability to provide informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Current Colchicine therapy
* Hepatic disease
* Established peripheral arterial disease (PAD) defined by self-report or ICD-10 codes
* Congestive heart failure classified as New York Heart Association (NYHA) Functional class III or IV
* Uncontrolled atrial fibrillation with resting heart rate \> 100 beats/min
* Dementia defined by self-report or ICD-10 codes (F01-F03)
* Alzheimer's disease defined by self-report or ICD-10 codes (G30)
* Any clinically active diagnosed infection requiring systemic antimicrobial therapy, positive microbiologic evidence of infection, or infection-related hospitalization within 30 days prior to study enrollment.
* Immunosuppression, including the use of immunosuppressive medications
* Current use of chemotherapy drugs or active cancer
* Pregnancy/breastfeeding
* Hospitalized within the past 6 months
* Allergic/intolerance to colchicine
* Use of P-glycoprotein (p-gp) inhibitor (such as Verapamil, Quinidine, Amiodarone, Ritonavir, Lopinavir/ritonavir, Saquinavir, Nelfinavir)
* Use of strong cytochrome P450 3A4 (CYP3A4) inhibitors (such as Ketoconazole, Itraconazole, Posaconazole, Voriconazole, Clarithromycin, Erythromycin)
* Human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) infection
* Gout attack ≥ 1 time per year
* Severe anemia (hemoglobin \< 8 g/dl for women and \< 9 g/dl for men)
* eGFR \<30 ml/min/1.73m2
* White blood cell count (WBC) \<3.0 x10\^9/L
* Aspartate aminotransferase (AST) or alanine aminotransferase (ALT) \> 3 x Upper Limit of Normal (ULN)
* Total bilirubin \>2 x ULN
* Glucose \>300mg/dL
* Uses recreational drugs
* Participant in other conflict clinical trial
* Unable to complete the study measurements
* Unable to undergo to computed tomography (CT)
* Unsafe to participate in this study per investigator's judgement
* Unable to read and speak English or Spanish
